labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks when PRs will be open to external contributors, which is a contribution-process question.

items.body:
Pull requests are currently limited to collaborators, so please describe the change in an issue first, as [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains. If you use AI tools, follow [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md). Maintainers have not announced a date for opening pull requests to external contributors. #4029 is an earlier request on the same topic. For general questions, use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
